# Copper Clothing

> Premium copper-infused apparel and home textiles featuring antimicrobial, moisture-wicking, and compression technologies for health-conscious consumers.

Copper Clothing specializes in copper ion-infused products across clothing, compression wear, towels, and household textiles. The brand leverages copper's natural antimicrobial properties combined with breathable fabrics like cotton and Lenzing viscose to create functional lifestyle products for everyday wear, athletic performance, and home use.

## Key Topics

- Copper-infused technology
- Compression socks
- Antimicrobial properties
- Cotton-bamboo blends
- Copper ions
- mmHg compression
- Breathable fabrics
- Lenzing Viscose
- Five-toe socks
- Healthcare-specific wear
- Odor-resistant textiles
- Athletic performance
- Pet care products
- Face masks
- Household bedding
